steps.name: Scent for you (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Shainic] in “Underground City of Tartarus” and visit [Frozen] in “Avalon.”

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: … I thought that if I just beat Vice, there would be only fun things to do... .
(Shaynick is lying down on the floor and writing 'I'm bored'. Melvik, who is familiar with the sight, pokes Shaynick's shoulder with a small stick.)

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Shinik, would you like to run a lap around Tartarus?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I hate running.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Then, was there anything you wanted to do? It's something different from usual.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Well? Because it’s something I want to do… . To begin with, I didn’t have any plans in life… .

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: You said you have a lot of work to do in the future.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's not something I want to do, but it's something I have to do... . Not right away though. Because I said I would talk to Io and Mr. Jiscard first.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I don't like it, but the Jude Kingdom is also involved, so I'll do whatever I can after that's resolved, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Shinik.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Found a funny face♡

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: %s, it’s been a while since I saw you. How have you been?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Melvik, how are you?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: While Shinik was away, not much happened except for catching a few demons trying to enter Tartarus.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Devil… yo. this?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: If Shinik isn't there, there are many demons and demons who will be drawn to the power emanating from the room in the abyss. So I put it in the hell room.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That's how I behave as my butler.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: After all, it's not normal.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Oh, that's right. Melvik, I remembered a plan.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: As expected, Shinik! Can you tell me what the plan is?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I need something, so %s and I are going to go find it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: With me? Which one?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'll tell you more details as I go. I need you to be there when I say hello.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Greetings… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then let's go together. Where should I go?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: So where will it go? First, let’s talk to Frozen in advance♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you Frozen?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yes, yes. Let's go first.

steps.name: Scent for you (2)
steps.objective:
Defeat [Tamiel] in 「Purgatory Azrael」, defeat <Perse's Gypsum>, and defeat [Convict Weiss] to obtain <Evidence of Bondage>. 
And report the quest to [Frozen] in 「Avalon」.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Luu's movements changed so someone said it was you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Frozen.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Did your conversation with Iris end well?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, it ended well.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Uh, who's behind... ? too… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Frozen, what were you just trying to say? You could say it was so small that you couldn't see it, or it was so small that you couldn't see it.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: There's no way I could say something like that to someone who has a bigger presence than anyone else, right?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Hey,
(Shynick is impressed by Frozen's reaction and looks at %s's face.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It would be good for you to learn something like that too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That would be nice, right?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Ahaha… . Because I was busy with work for the Pope. Oh, forget this. By the way, what brought you here, Shinik?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Looking for something♡

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Are you trying to find something to give to Medea like last time?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: What, did you know?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: It's really just by chance that we've increased our detection capabilities a little bit. Should I say it's thanks to Velosh... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Velosh?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: It cannot be said that the influence of the divine power that escaped from him was completely absent. Plus, Lou has become a bit heavy, so it's hard on my shoulders.
(Lou frowns while listening to Frozen's words.)

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Lou, I don’t know anything else, but let’s admit that it has gotten heavier. ha ha ha. Anyway, Shinik, what are you looking for?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: When I went to the Underworld and came back, there was a flower I brought with me. I need that. I think I can say hello properly if that's the case.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Is it a flower? I think I saw a flower in Purgatory that didn't fit with Avalon... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Was it held by an angel of chaos? ? I'll have to go and look for it first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Frozen, are those doors still left? Can I go back in there?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Of course. What does the state of Avalon look like right now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What I felt while coming here... . hmm… . I don't feel anything.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Those doors are still there, and you can go in there. The appearance of Vanitas and Purgatory that we saw remains the same. At that time, I thought it would definitely disappear.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: You may not believe it, but it's true. I don't know what world Weiss was talking about, but... .

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: So I'm looking for something to report to the church, but I can't find anything like it.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: So, on your way, you ask %s to find it for you. You seem to be surprisingly good at finding things, huh?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: I heard a while ago that something was found behind the scenes. That means that wherever %s steps, it becomes a new place and path.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: New places and roads... .

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: … I don't know what path it will take, but I hope it is a good path. Don’t get lost at the crossroads of fate… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You walk towards the place you believe in♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Because beings like Weiss remain in this world and may come again.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Shinik, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Oh, it's okay. Because you won't die easily♡ I hope you find them all at once while you're in.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: That's right. That friend went to one place several times because of a letter I had previously sealed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Shinik, if you bring me that flower, I will bless you in another form.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Okay. If the touch of death touches it, it may wither. But are you still going to stay here?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Yes, I'm looking for evidence nearby to submit to the church... . I'll be waiting here.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I need to finish it quickly. I don't want to stay in Avalon for long. It's really annoying... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll come back.

steps.name: Scent for you (3)
steps.objective:
1. Clear 「Dreaming Oneiro」 and talk to [Shiinic].
2. Defeat [Velosh] in 「Vanitas」 and obtain <Burning Wood>.
3. Talk to [Shinic] in the “Underground City of Tartarus” and complete the quest.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'm here.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Are you here, Shinik? Seeing that you were having fun, it looks like you found your item.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Frozen, the item is here.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Shinik made a really good choice in taking you with him.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: This flower is rare and special, so we have to make it even more special♡ Be careful.
(Frozen holds a gypsum flower and prays with her eyes closed. The spirit Luu draws a small light from somewhere and sends it to the flower.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: After living for a long time, I received blessings from Demigod... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's fascinating.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Shinik, please take it.
(When Shinik accepts the gypsum flower, the small petals flutter and turn into small lights. And they come around the surprised Shinik.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: To be honest, I wasn't confident, but Frozen does this for me. If you have a longing heart, the light will change.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: The Bible says that this light arises if you have a heart for someone who leaves death and longs for it.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: All you have to do is send this light to where Shinik’s longing is heading.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I will definitely do that. Thank you, Frozen.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: What is it, Shinik?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: %s, I have a favor to ask.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please speak.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Guide me through the forest of Oneiro.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will guide you.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Frozen, see you later. Oh, you should only come when it's a good thing. It's usually not a big deal when a Demigod comes to visit, so only come when it's a good thing!

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Haha, I'll keep that in mind.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Frozen, then we will go.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Yes, be careful.
(After wandering for a long time in a forest where there were no dreamers, Shinik and %s's footsteps stop.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, this is where I met the guardian of the forest and met Eda.
(Shainik looks around quietly and discovers a flower field full of green and yellow leaves.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: This flower... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: As expected, it withers because there is no one to take care of it.
(Shynick reaches out in a low posture and touches the flower petals. Then, the light circling in his arms gently descends into the flower field.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Eda, I'm sorry. I should have come right after hearing your story, but I came now.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Am I too late? Don't worry, I'll keep your ribbon safe.
(Shynick caresses the flower petals for a long time, unable to continue speaking.)

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: “Don’t be sorry. Because Shinik did nothing wrong.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What is it? Is it because of my mood? Where is the voice coming from?)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I guess I forgot about it for a long time. We could have met sooner... . Sorry.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I have good friends now, so I won't be lonely until we meet again. and… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: When we meet again... . Just like that time a long time ago... . Be my friend so I don't get bored.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Then sleep peacefully… .
(Shaynick smiles brightly and stands up.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Still, I'm glad that when I came back from the dead, I brought the Gypsophila with me. You can convey your feelings like this... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shinik, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: If it's not okay, are you going to die?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's not true, but since you said that, it seems like you're okay with it.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Hehe, let's go now. ah! I forgot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: When I went to the empty purgatory earlier, I forgot that Vanitas had to go too. Sorry.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You need to repair a burning wheel, so find wood that looks similar to the wheel and light it on fire. Then cut it to size and put it here.
(Shinyk hands a sack of unknown whereabouts to %s.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: If the wheel is not repaired, the novice goddess will have a hard time because she will have a lot of work to do. Can you come back now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If that's the case, I'll come right away.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: As expected, you react immediately to the work of a novice goddess.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Bring just one piece of wood. Just one is enough.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'll stay here for a bit and then go to Tartarus.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later, Shinik.
(As %s disappears, Shinik quietly looks at the withered flower field.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'd like to take some flowers and plant them in Tartarus, but I'm not sure if it will work. Can this flower grow properly in Tartarus?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Should I ask Medea? Oh, I don't know. It's a hassle to come back... .
(Shainik looks blankly at the sky and mutters.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Beginner Goddess♡ Can I use Goddess’s chance? You said that one of your friends is a flower spirit, right?
(As soon as Shinik finishes speaking, something falls on the flower field. After a while, a girl covered in flower petals wakes up from among the flower fields angrily.)
Iris, I will get scolded if I send you out suddenly!! Did you understand?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Seeing the scent of flowers, it seems that the spirit of flowers has been sent. Are you a spirit?
Did you call me? I'm a Jeongneung kid who just comes to ask who's calling.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Judging from the way he speaks, it seems like he is from ancient times. You can trust me and ask for it♡ I’m Shineek. Of Tartarus… .

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: My Zoe, I know your eyes. Can I help you?
(Tartaros, which is usually quiet, is noisy. Dust is rising here and there, as if construction has started.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Cluck cluck. Is something going on in Tartarus?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Just trying to move for the first time in a while. By the way, did you get what I told you about?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, here. As Shinik said, I lit a tree that looked good, cut it into pieces, and brought it home.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But this sack. It looks like the bag I used to put the curing ring in... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I saw that and roughly made it ♡ Is it useful?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, it was very useful. But it's wood made by burning. It's burning, but strangely it doesn't feel hot to the touch.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That's because it's from another world. Even the actions that take place in that space seem to be applied differently from our world.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Burning Wheel, Vanitas... . If Weiss hadn't come to our world from the beginning, we wouldn't have had to go.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Eh, I don't know. I don't like complicated things♡ It's already happened, so what should I do?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: So… . I'm going to use this to repair the cart wheel. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shinik, you look happy.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Because I have something to do... . %s, I'm having fun right now. Thanks to you, I don't think I'll ever be bored again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's good.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Hehe, I'm glad you came to Tartarus.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will continue to come and help you in the future.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You have your own work to do. I will find and do what needs to be done here on my own. So don't come to help, come to play. Okay?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: As we talk, it somehow feels like Io. Melvik, leave it here.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Yes, Shinik. Uh, %s, are you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I went there. Melvik, what is that?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Shinik brought a lot of flower seedlings, saying he would plant them when he came back.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: … I don't know how much this is, but it's enough to fill Tartarus.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This flower... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I saw it in Oneiro Forest... It was definitely withered. How did they revive it?)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: A beginner goddess called a friend.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, Zoe… What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: The ancient spirit, who was quiet and quiet, listened to me and returned. Those flowers are what I'm going to do now.
(Shainik smiles brightly and looks at a flower blooming in the dirt.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Melvik, I'm going to fill this whole place with flowers now. My strength will bloom♡ Now I want to save people instead of killing them.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Great job, Shinik.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Oh, that's right. %s… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Help me plant flowers!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't think it's been that long since you told me not to come to help, but to come to play.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That's from next time! Ask for help today!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How much can I do?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Tartarus from end to end?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: How long has it been since Shinik has shown this much motivation? . I, too, have come across days like this in my life.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: There's nothing this young guy can't do.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Shinik, I am still the second adult in this village after Shinik. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: When did you find this guy, treat him, and bring him back… . Melvik, this may be a long story, but let’s take a break from work for a moment.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Yes, I knew that would happen and I prepared refreshments.
(Melvik opens the picnic basket he was carrying and prepares drinks and snacks in front of Shinick and %s.)
(After Shaynick drinks with a satisfied expression, he starts talking about the time he met Melvik a long time ago.)
(A story about how he and Medea found a dying Melvik in a village and went to Lapier, the tree of God, to save him.)
(As if that wasn't enough, Shinik continues to bring up old stories that he hasn't told anyone, not even Melbig.)
(There was a girl who thought everything was boring. New encounters and separations, although it seemed like it was only a short time in her life, the girl definitely changed in that time.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: End of story♡

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Then let's have fun! It'll be fun!
